# Example store listing

Each field is the first fenced block under its heading. Anything else is notes.

## App name (30 char max)

```
Example
```

## Short description (80 char max)

**Primary**

```
Ship the thing, then tell everyone.
```

Alternates:

```
not this one
```

## Full description (4000 char max)

```
Example does one thing well.
```

## App Store description (4000 char max)

```
Example does one thing well, on iPhone.
```

## Keywords (100 char max)

```
example,demo
```

```
https://example.com/support
```

```
https://example.com/privacy
```

